housing.text: Magsig said constructing more housing would help improve housing affordability.
housing.quote: Housing affordability will improve as better paying jobs are created and more housing is constructed.

safety.text: Magsig pledged to oppose policies he considers anti-law-enforcement and support law-enforcement personnel.
safety.quote: Public safety is also a top priority. I will oppose anti-law enforcement policies and support the men and women who work every day to keep our communities safe.

immigration.text: Magsig endorsed SB 554, which would require greater local cooperation with ICE in cases involving specified serious crimes.
immigration.quote: A primary strength of this bill lies in its ability to prioritize public safety by facilitating the removal of serious criminals from our communities, regardless of immigration status,

guns.text: Magsig co-sponsored an approved county letter opposing SJR-7, which proposed nationwide age limits, universal background checks, waiting periods and an assault-weapons ban.
guns.quote: Authorize the Board of Supervisors to send a Letter of Opposition to SJR-7 Federal constitutional convention: firearms, also known as the "Right to Safety Amendment".

cannabis.text: As board chairman, Magsig supported extending Fresno County’s ban on marijuana cultivation and commercial or medicinal sales.
cannabis.quote: We do have concerns about commercial sales as well as medicinal sales here in the county of Fresno. And so the ordinance we enacted today does not allow commercial or medicinal sales within the county of Fresno,

energy.text: Magsig said expanding domestic oil production would lower family costs and increase Central Valley investment.
energy.quote: By responsibly expanding domestic oil and strengthening our agricultural economy, I believe we can lower costs for families and drive meaningful investment into the Central Valley.

tax.text: Brown says California leaders should lower taxes and has proposed income-tax exemptions for essential workers and overtime earnings.
tax.quote: They should work to lower taxes, not raise them.

safety.text: Brown answered yes to shifting homelessness and mental-health responses from law enforcement to trained social-service providers.
safety.quote: Will you support policies that shift public safety responses to trained social service providers for homelessness and mental health incidents?

sentencing.text: Brown answered yes to investing in community programs while rejecting longer sentences and increased penalties.
sentencing.quote: Will you publicly advocate for greater investment in community-based programs and services and reject legislation that lengthens sentences and increases penalties?

immigration.text: Brown answered yes to opposing ICE raids that detain people without evidence or due process and to denouncing expanded immigration detention.
immigration.quote: Do you publicly oppose ICE raids that have detained people without evidence or due process based on the color of their skin, language they speak, or occupation?

energy.text: Brown criticizes regulations that make imported oil easier to obtain than oil produced in California while also calling environmental protection non-negotiable.
energy.quote: While protecting our environment is non-negotiable, we've created such a complex regulatory maze that buying oil overseas is more straightforward than producing it here.
